components.remaining: Complete proofs of Kolaitis manuscript Theorems 5.10 (Connectivity not monadic ESO-definable on finite structures (V,E,Suc), E binary, Suc the graph of a successor function on V) and 5.11 (on finite ordered graphs (V,E,<=), <= a linear order on V). Both are now stated with Kolaitis's exact hypotheses (p. 29) under cited= to de Rougemont 1987 and Schwentick 1994, with the built-in-predicate remark and proved failure boundaries (reduct transfer, binary-ESO definability of connectivity, failure of d-type counting on ordered graphs); the proofs themselves are not written. The version of record (Springer 2007 chapter) was not read; the 1 August 2003 manuscript is followed and cited with its own locators, and the reader text says so. Kolaitis does not specify, for Thms 5.10/5.11, which reading of 'connected' (symmetric closure or strong) applies when E is not symmetric; the reader text records this.
components.blocker: blocked_source for the proofs of Thms 5.10/5.11: the manuscript states them without proof. Tried in block 2 (2026-10-12): Schwentick, On winning Ehrenfeucht games and monadic NP, APAL 79 (1996) 61-92 at ScienceDirect (pii 0168007295000303) returned HTTP 403; web search found no author-hosted, CiteSeerX or PhilArchive full text; Schwentick FOCS 1994 only on IEEE Xplore; Fagin-Stockmeyer-Vardi 1995 HTTP 403 (block 1); de Rougemont 1987 (Z. Math. Logik Grundlag. Math. 33) not reached. The bib entries deRougemont1987 and Schwentick1994 carry bibliographic data from Kolaitis's reference list only; no locator into them is used.
